patch_description:
This implementation replaces the state-space Kalman approach with a causal multiscale robust-regression filter. At each trailing-window endpoint it fits both a slow and a fast exponentially weighted local-linear model using Huber reweighting. The slow model supplies stable denoising, while the fast model supplies low-lag response to genuine changes.

The models are blended only when the fast fit is reliable: its residual scale, endpoint residual, and agreement with the slow slope determine its influence. A final causal trend gate attenuates only weak counter-direction movements, reducing noise-induced reversals without preventing sustained trend changes. The algorithm preserves the original input/output API and trailing-window output alignment.
